full_judgment: 2. The respondent hereof as plaintiff filed the Title Suit No.88 of 2000 for declaration that the Mutation Khatian No. 270 was illegal, inoperative and collusive and made behind his back con-tending, inter alia, that the said Khatian has been prepared in the name of the defendant-petitioner hereof having no right, title and interest or possession in the suit land and that the suit land measuring 57 decimals of land out of 5.50 acres appertaining D.S. Khatian No.  82 corresponding to M. R.R Khatian No. 134 originally belonged to three sons of Doyaram Shil and that the said three sons while owning and possessing the suit land, one of them named Balaram Shil died leaving behind his other two brothers, namely, Rarnkanai Shil and R. amkumar Shil, who being the legal heirs and successor-in-interest inherited Balaramrs share. Subsequently Ramkumar Shil died leaving behind two sons namely, Kalinath Shil and Jadunath Shil to inherit his share and that Jadunath Shil died leaving behind one son Kcshab Chandra Shil and that the plaintiff Sanjoy Kumar Shil by virtue gift deeds dated 01.06.1992 and 28.06.1993 from the legal heirs in succession became owner possessor of 81 decimals of land including the suit land by erecting dwelling house as well as by growing seasonal crops thereon and that the impugned mutation khatian having been created, without notice, collusively in the name of the defendant-petitioner, the plaintiff-respondent has been compelled to file the suit.
